summary: iter447 FINAL no-code acceptance test at scale (500 lots) — ALL 10 steps PASSED. Generated a valid 500-row CSV with deterministic unique 17-char VINs (20 QC rows carry title_fr). Wizard advances Step1→Step2→Step3 correctly. Step 2 (Review) renders all 500 rows in ~1.0 s (well under the 15 s acceptance threshold); scroll top/bottom is smooth. No client-side search/errors-only filter exists in the current build — documented as a UX gap, not a bug. Atomic confirm creates exactly 500 lots (verified in Mongo: lots=500, all status='draft_no_photos', media empty). Capacity chip flips to '500/500 used — 0 remaining'. Photo Studio Step 3 renders 500 lot cards with 500 red 'Needs 1 photo' pills. VIN photo auto-match works: uploading 10 photos → 7 auto-matched (3 full 17-char, 2 unambiguous last-8, 2 unambiguous last-6), 3 landed in Unmatched tray (1 ambiguous last-6 shared by 2 VINs, plus IMG_1234.jpg and stock_A-4471.jpg). Go Live button label correctly reads 'Go Live (493 lot(s) need a photo)' and is disabled. Direct API POST /activate?intent=live returns HTTP 400 with detail.code='lots_missing_photos', bilingual EN/FR messages, and lots_missing_photos list length = 493 — gate math is exact. Cleanup complete: 2 iter447 events cancelled, CSV + photo dir removed. No code changes were required.

issues: No client-side search box or 'errors-only' filter — with 500 rows, users must scroll manually to locate errors. NOT a bug (spec confirmed absence), but a UX gap to consider for pilot polish.
Card copy still reads 'Bulk-add up to 50 lots at once from a spreadsheet.' — but the capacity chip shows /500 and the backend accepts 500. Copy is stale; minor.

evidence.duplicate_vin_cross_event_guard_verified: Second import of the same 500 VINs into a different draft event correctly flagged every row with 'VIN is already in another open multi-lot event' and disabled the submit button — cross-event dedup works.
evidence.manual_assignment_note: Manual-assign via <select> could not be fully driven via change-event in headless mode (the React state onChange handler expects a real user gesture), but the Assign selects render for every unmatched item with populated lot options — visible in the screenshot. Backend photo-gate is the authoritative check and passed cleanly.

critical_code_review_comments: Wizard-level integration is now correct end-to-end (Step1→Step4). Previous iter447 navigate() bug is fixed.
Atomic confirm at scale (500 lots inserted in a single call) succeeds without partial writes.
Photo-gate on /activate?intent=live returns properly structured 400 with code, bilingual messages, and a full list of the missing lots — good for client-side re-highlighting.
Cross-event VIN dedup works: retrying the same CSV in a fresh draft under the same seller correctly flags all 500 rows with the conflict.event_id link.
Review table renders 500 rows in ~1 s in this environment — no virtualisation needed for the pilot scale.
